description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans' grain factory and grain type resolution mechanisms, validating behavior such as ambiguous type handling, resolution via full names and prefixes, inheritance hierarchies, and key-based grain creation.

classes.name: GrainFactoryTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying Orleans grain factory resolution and behavior in various scenarios.

methods.name: GetGrain_Ambiguous
methods.description: Tests that requesting a grain with ambiguous type resolution throws an ArgumentException.

methods.name: GetGrain_Ambiguous_WithDefault
methods.description: Verifies that Orleans uses the default grain implementation when multiple exist.

methods.name: GetGrain_WithFullName
methods.description: Tests grain resolution using the full type name.

methods.name: GetGrain_WithPrefix
methods.description: Tests grain resolution using a class name prefix.

methods.name: GetGrain_AmbiguousPrefix
methods.description: Ensures that ambiguous prefixes throw an exception.

methods.name: GetGrain_WrongPrefix
methods.description: Checks that invalid prefixes result in an exception.

methods.name: GetGrain_Derived_NoPrefix
methods.description: Resolves grains implementing derived interfaces without prefixes.

methods.name: GetGrain_Derived_WithFullName
methods.description: Resolves derived grains explicitly via full type name.

methods.name: GetGrain_Derived_WithFullName_FromBase
methods.description: Accesses derived grain via base interface with full name.

methods.name: GetGrain_Derived_WithPrefix
methods.description: Resolves derived grains using prefix in inheritance hierarchy.

methods.name: GetGrain_Derived_WithWrongPrefix
methods.description: Checks error handling for wrong prefix with derived grains.

methods.name: GetGrain_OneImplementation_NoPrefix
methods.description: Automatically resolves single implementation without prefix.

methods.name: GetGrain_OneImplementation_Prefix
methods.description: Resolves single implementation explicitly via full name.

methods.name: GetGrain_MultipleUnrelatedInterfaces
methods.description: Tests grains implementing multiple unrelated interfaces.

methods.name: GetStringGrain
methods.description: Creates a grain with a string key.

methods.name: GetGuidGrain
methods.description: Creates a grain with a GUID key.
